issue.close_reason:
Rewrote the three redaction-family targets onto the checkpoint-set-v2 spec 9 contract (commit 7bce11a0, pushed). A forced sharded request publishes set-v2, so the retained-generation reset leg asserts pointer mode set-v2, the checkpoint-fingerprint leg accepts set/shard/ selectors, the storage round-trip reads the set-v2 manifest's class=="redaction" shards, and the duplicate-secret sweep fixture counts checkpoint copies instead of per-shard spread. No leg asserts the retired forced-sharded-v1 pointer mode or shard-path layout anymore.

The redaction_storage:193 duplicate-record-ID finding was NOT dissolved by the fixture rewrite: it is a corpus-writer defect (keyed_record_id partitions an acknowledged redaction finding and its acknowledgment into one prefix space). A second same-family defect also surfaced: checkpoint_issue_paths has no set-v2 arm, so the retained redaction lookup rejects set-v2 pointers ("unsupported mode", masked as "could not scan retained checkpoint redaction targets"). Filed blocking proposal bead beadrs-9116e1a9 (proposal-pending, human) with repro, root cause, the verified-but-uncommitted WIP fixes, and un-pin instructions; pinned the five set-v2 legs with contract notes naming it. With the WIP src fixes applied on a clean extraction all three targets pass UNPINNED 11/11, 5/5, 5/5 in the parent verification env; monolithic legs keep coverage behind the pins at HEAD.

All verification ran on private clean extractions of pushed 7bce11a0 under /data/build/bead-rs/, never the shared dirty tree; fmt and clippy clean.

issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted 2026-08-16) decides on a `ready_frontier` check in `bead doctor` for the starvation mode behind the 2026-08-16 field sweep (583 open-but-assigned issues across 47 workspaces, ten empty ready frontiers, doctor reporting healthy throughout), but no open bead tracks it. Work: implement the check under doctor's `dependencies` scope — warn when open issues carry an assignee (open+assigned is excluded from the ready frontier and unclaimable), name a bounded sample of the offending ids, and state the exact remedy `bead update <id> --clear-assignee`. Advisory only: doctor never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`. Tests: warning fires for open+assigned, stays silent for in_progress/closed/deferred, the id sample is bounded, and `--repair` performs no mutation. Keep the query independent of the separate doctor blocked-count column fix (beadrs-90abfec2) so neither bead expands the other's scope.

---
Priority: P1
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add doctor ready_frontier check diagnosing assigned-open starvation (ADR-005)
